description: Parliament - Sri Jayawardanapura - Kotte - Presidential Elections (Special Provisions) Act No. 2 of 1981 - The Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe Member of Parliament Has Been Declared Elected by Parliament on Wednesday, the 20th of July 2022 as the Eighth Executive President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.
reasoning: This gazette content specifically announces the declaration of an elected President through a parliamentary process, which falls under electoral matters. It references the Presidential Elections (Special Provisions) Act and details the election of a specific individual to the presidency through parliamentary procedure, making it clearly related to election results and declarations - the core focus of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
